newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: At least 85 said killed in Sri Lanka boat disaster.
newsitem.headline: At least 85 said killed in Sri Lanka boat disaster.

text.p: At least 85 people, mostly women and children, died when a fishing trawler carrying 150 Tamil refugees capsized in the Mannar Sea off northern Sri Lanka, the rebel Tamil Tiger radio said on Friday.
The radio, monitored in the northern town of Vavuniya, said the boat was on its way to India when it capsized late on Wednesday.
At least 85 said killed in Sri Lanka boat disaster
It said 20 people and two trawler crew members had been rescued and that a search was on for more survivors. It added that 62 bodies had been identified.

The radio said the trawler had gone barely a mile before it capsized. It did not say why the trawler capsized or who was carrying out rescue operations. Sri Lanka military officials were not immediately available for comment.

The political wing of the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE), which is fighting a 13-year-old war for a separate homeland for minority Tamils in Sri Lanka's north and east, has asked all Tamils to mourn the deaths by flying black flags.

"We request all the Tamils to observe a day of mourning on Saturday the 22nd, to respect the Tamils who died in the sea drowning while they tried to escape the Sinhalese forces who are engaged in Edi Bala (brave force) operations and also their attacks," they said in a statement on Friday.
